name: Coinbase AgentKit
description: Coinbase's onchain agent toolkit providing pre-built action primitives for Base: token transfers, swaps, NFT interactions, CDP wallet management, and x402 payment flows. Accelerates Base-native agent development by abstracting onchain tool definition boilerplate.

ecosystem_fit.notes: AgentKit is purpose-built for Base. All pre-built actions target Base/EVM. The CDP wallet integration (Coinbase Developer Platform) is Base-native.

AgentKit's EVM actions technically support Ethereum mainnet but the product is optimized for Base. EVM-agnostic agent tooling (Vercel AI SDK with custom tools) is more appropriate for pure Ethereum builds.
Farcaster apps on Base can use AgentKit for onchain actions, but AgentKit adds no Farcaster-specific capabilities.

common_pairings.context: AgentKit provides the onchain tool definitions (what the agent can do); Vercel AI SDK provides the LLM reasoning loop (how the agent decides what to do). AgentKit's @coinbase/agentkit-vercel-ai-sdk adapter integrates directly with the Vercel AI SDK tool interface.
AgentKit handles onchain actions; Alchemy provides the RPC and webhook infrastructure for chain state and event triggers.
Trigger.dev provides durable execution and retry for AgentKit agent runs. AgentKit is the action layer; Trigger.dev is the orchestration layer.
AgentKit's default uses CDP Wallet (Coinbase Developer Platform) for key management. Turnkey can be substituted when independent MPC key management with custom policy enforcement is required.

trust_evidence.description: Built by Coinbase Developer Platform team. Actively maintained and promoted as the official Coinbase tool for building onchain agents.
Rapid release cadence as of 2026-05. Breaking changes between minor versions have been observed. Trust state elevated from experimental to emerging based on increased adoption signals.

Adoption is growing but concentrated in Base hackathon and early-stage projects. Production deployments are limited compared to Vercel AI SDK. Trust state remains emerging until production adoption is more broadly confirmed.

scale_guidance.hackathon: AgentKit's pre-built action primitives dramatically accelerate hackathon development for Base-native agents. Recommended when Base is the confirmed target and shipping speed matters more than portability.
scale_guidance.mvp: Verify current trust state before committing to AgentKit for MVP. The action abstractions reduce boilerplate but create AgentKit version coupling. Ensure actions you depend on are stable across releases.
scale_guidance.production: Evaluate AgentKit's trust state at time of production deployment — it was 'emerging' as of 2026-05. Production agents that require stability should use Vercel AI SDK with custom tool definitions. Reassess every 90 days as AgentKit matures.

alternatives.when_to_prefer: When portability across chains matters (not Base-only), when production stability is required, or when the pre-built AgentKit action primitives don't match the required onchain actions. Vercel AI SDK requires writing custom tool definitions but is production-stable and ecosystem-agnostic.

anti_patterns: Using AgentKit for production when trust state is 'emerging' and production stability is required — verify current trust state before production deployment. AgentKit breaking changes have occurred between minor versions.

Using AgentKit outside Base ecosystem — the pre-built action primitives are Base/EVM specific. For Solana or multi-chain agents, the abstractions don't apply and Vercel AI SDK with custom tools is the right choice.

Conflating AgentKit (action layer) with the LLM reasoning framework — AgentKit provides WHAT the agent can do; Vercel AI SDK (or LangChain) provides HOW the agent decides. Both are needed; neither replaces the other.
Not monitoring AgentKit releases — rapid release cadence means actions and interfaces can change significantly between releases. Pin versions explicitly and monitor changelogs.
